capabilities: Render Cooklang recipes inside code blocks in view mode
Display a recipe's ingredients, cookware, and method
Optionally show cook time and serving size at the top of the block
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is brief and shows no usage examples.
problem: Obsidian cannot render Cooklang recipe syntax, so recipes in notes stay as plain code text.
summary: Codeblock renderer that displays recipes written in Cooklang with ingredients, cookware, method, cook time, and serving size.
